knowledge_point.title: Determining Whether Two Vectors are Parallel

question.:question/problem: Given that $24a - 8b$ and $λ(3a - b)$ are equal (non-zero) vectors, find the scale factor $λ$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that

$$
λ(3a - b)=λ(3)a+λ(-1)b.
$$

The same scale factor must multiply the whole non-zero vector. Comparing the two coefficients gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
λ &= \frac{24}{3} = 8 \\
λ &= \frac{-8}{-1} = 8
\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that

$$
24a - 8b=8(3a - b).
$$

Therefore,

$$
λ=8
$$

The two non-zero vectors are parallel. Their directions are the same because the factor is positive.
